title: iniBuilds Global Jet Officially Released for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
summary: The highly anticipated iniBuilds Global Jet is now available through the Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 Marketplace for £56.39, bringing detailed long-range, large-cabin business aviation to the simulator.
body:
The wait is officially over. iniBuilds has released its highly anticipated Global Jet for Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024, with the aircraft now available exclusively through the in-simulator Marketplace at a UK price of **£56.39**.

![](/assets/GlexTrailer9.png)

Based on the Bombardier Global 6000, the aircraft represents iniBuilds' first venture into dedicated business aviation and marks a significant milestone for virtual pilots seeking a sophisticated, long-range executive jet.

First unveiled at FSimUK in October 2026, the Global Jet has attracted considerable interest throughout its development, with iniBuilds subsequently releasing detailed systems previews, an official trailer and an extensive 75-minute demonstration flight.

### Advanced Flight Deck and Aircraft Systems

![](/assets/GlexTrailer1-1.png)

The Global Jet features a highly customised recreation of the Vision Flight Deck, offering extensive flight management capabilities designed to replicate the operational demands of modern business aviation.

Key developer-announced features include:

- Advanced FMS with SimBrief integration.
- Secondary flight planning and multiple destination management.
- Vertical navigation with speed restrictions and step-climb recommendations.
- Head-up display with synthetic terrain representation.
- Synthetic vision and advanced weather radar.
- Detailed electrical, hydraulic and environmental systems.
- CPDLC integration with supported third-party services.
- Electronic checklists and simulated aircraft failures.
- Integrated take-off and landing performance calculations.
- Automated step climbs and pause at top of descent.
- Authentic Rolls-Royce BR710 engine recordings by Echo19.

### Luxury Beyond the Flight Deck

![](/assets/GlexTrailer7.png)

The Global Jet includes two distinct, fully walkable passenger cabin configurations — Classic and Futuristic — offering different interpretations of luxury executive travel.

Support for the JetCard system further enhances the business aviation experience, complementing the separately available iniBuilds Global FBO add-on.

### Pricing and Availability

- **Release date:** 24 November 2026
- **UK Marketplace price:** £56.39
- **Simulator:** Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
- **Availability:** In-simulator Marketplace

A comprehensive 187-page aircraft manual, FAQs, additional liveries and a paint kit are also available.

### A Significant Step Forward for Virtual Business Aviation

The arrival of the iniBuilds Global Jet represents an important expansion of the large-cabin, ultra-long-range business aircraft category within Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024.

With the Embraer Praetor 600 provisionally scheduled for December and several other executive aircraft currently in development, the future of virtual business aviation is looking increasingly promising.

BizJet Pilot will continue to follow the Global Jet, including subsequent updates, community feedback and developments surrounding this exciting addition to the simulator.
